friendly_name: ADR-0082 slices 2 to 4: one graph walk, rules from the factory
purpose_context: Epic #636 migrates the charter service to ADR-0082: the packs domain owns every graph walk, the rules come from one factory and run in one walker. Slices 2 to 4 (#637, #638, #639) move the cycle, group and descending walks into PackGraph, the own-closure rules into packs.domain.rules behind a ValidationWalker, and the relation and edge-index refusals into relations-phase rules. Refusal codes, details and the order of findings stay the same; they unblock the remaining pack-check checks of #632.
purpose_tldr: Move every pack-graph walk, the own-closure rules and the relation rules into the packs domain, with no change to any answer the service gives.
